name: @evavo/art-studio
description: Governed art production system for game, digital and print assets.

scripts.dev:worker: pnpm run build:domain && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-studio-worker start -- daemon
scripts.worker:once: pnpm run build:domain && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-studio-worker start -- once
scripts.worker:until-idle: pnpm run build:domain && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-studio-worker start -- until-idle
scripts.build:domain: pnpm --filter @evavo/art-contracts build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-direction build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-sprite-planner build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-core build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-repo-inspector build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-quality build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-finalizer build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-media build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-delivery-optimizer build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-audio-delivery build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-provider-canvas build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-godot build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-godot-sprite-effects build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-artifacts build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-providers build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-selection build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-sprite-family build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-repair build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-runtime build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-book-runtime build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-sprite-supervisor build
scripts.check: pnpm run toolchain:check:installed && pnpm run toolchain:test && pnpm run brass:review:mcp:check && pnpm run brass:production:mcp:check && pnpm run reference-intelligence:check && pnpm run image-processing-recipes:check && pnpm run governed-workspace-handoff:check && pnpm run raw-art:production:check && pnpm run raw-art:production:test && pnpm run build:domain && pnpm run sharp-exact-runtime:test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm run foundation:check && pnpm run foundation:delivery:check
scripts.media:check: pnpm --filter @evavo/art-delivery-optimizer test && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-audio-delivery test && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-godot-sprite-effects test
